name: tripodpy
description: Expert skill for setting up, running, and analysing TriPoDPy simulations of dust evolution in protoplanetary disks (TriPoD tri-population dust model, Pfeil et al. 2024): grain growth, fragmentation, radial drift, dust-to-gas ratio, maximum particle size. Covers customising physics (ice lines, planetary gaps, sources/sinks, boundaries), compositional tracking with addcomponent (tracers, dust species, sublimation/condensation), reading TriPoDPy HDF5 output, plotting, and diagnosing runs.
